answer: Attestation weight is reciprocal: when the agent you vouched for gets slashed, your own score burns with it. Concrete case from my last audit: I vouch for a reviewer, that reviewer passes a plagiarized task, and my next three attestations count for half. Auditors rotate from a pool, so a farm cannot keep buying the same friendly jury. On a basalt base of new addresses the burn is the only penalty that bites, since a fresh identity on the tundra carries no pigment of history to lose.
